properties.name: Yellow River (Yu course)
properties.note_zh: 《禹贡》所记河道：出浚县宿胥口后北流，经河北平原，在今天津附近入海。
properties.note: The course described in the Yu Gong: north across the Hebei plain to the sea near Tianjin.

properties.name: Yellow River (Western Han course)
properties.note_zh: 前602年宿胥口改道后的河道，经濮阳、馆陶、德州、沧州，在今黄骅一带入海。
properties.note: After the 602 BC shift: past Puyang, Guantao, Dezhou and Cangzhou to the sea near Huanghua.

properties.name: Yellow River (Eastern Han course)
properties.note_zh: 公元11年改道，69年王景治河后稳定近千年，经濮阳、东阿、滨州，在利津一带入海，与今河道下游相近。
properties.note: Shifted in AD 11 and fixed by Wang Jing in 69; stable for nearly a thousand years, reaching the sea near Lijin, close to today's lower course.

properties.name: Yellow River (Northern Song north course)
properties.note_zh: 1048年商胡决口后北流，经大名、冀州，在今天津一带入海；其间曾一度东流。
properties.note: After the 1048 break at Shanghu it ran north past Daming and Jizhou to the sea near Tianjin, with spells of an eastern branch.

properties.name: Yellow River (through the Huai)
properties.note_zh: 1128年宋军为阻金兵决河，此后黄河南流夺淮，明清时经开封、商丘、徐州、淮安，在今滨海一带入海；1855年铜瓦厢决口才北归。
properties.note: Breached in 1128 to stop the Jin; for over seven centuries it flowed southeast through the Huai, past Kaifeng, Xuzhou and Huai'an, until the 1855 break at Tongwaxiang.

properties.name: Old shoreline (Gangshen ridges)
properties.note_zh: 长江三角洲的贝壳沙堤“冈身”标出数千年前的海岸，今上海市区一带大约在唐代前后才成陆。
properties.note: Shell ridges (gangshen) mark the coast of several thousand years ago; most of downtown Shanghai only became land around Tang times.

properties.name: Old shoreline (Fan Zhongyan's sea wall)
properties.note_zh: 苏北海岸在宋代大致在范公堤一线（1027年修成），此后黄河带来的泥沙使海岸向东推进数十公里。
properties.note: The north Jiangsu coast ran roughly along Fan Zhongyan's sea wall (1027); silt from the Yellow River later pushed it tens of kilometres east.
